recent_posts.title: The new Run dialog: faster, cleaner, and more capable
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft's Windows Terminal and PowerToys team has shipped a rebuilt Run dialog (Win+R) for Windows 11. The new dialog is built with C#/WinUI 3 and compiled with .NET AOT, achieving a 94ms median time-to-show versus the previous 103ms. It features a Fluent Design look with dark mode support, tilde (~\) shortcut for quick home directory navigation, and is powered by the same CmdPal codebase used in PowerToys. The redesign was data-driven, measuring usage patterns across 35 million samples before making decisions like removing the rarely-used browse button. Currently rolling out as opt-in on the Windows Insider Experimental Channel.

recent_posts.title: PowerToys 0.99 is here: new monitor controls, easier window management, and Dock upgrades
recent_posts.summary: PowerToys 0.99 ships two new preview utilities: Power Display for controlling monitor settings (brightness, contrast, color profiles) directly from the system tray, and Grab And Move for dragging/resizing windows via Alt+Click anywhere on the window. Command Palette and the Dock receive major improvements including a Compact Dock mode, persistent calculator history, better pinning controls, crash fixes, and Windows Terminal profile pinning. Keyboard Manager gains editable recorded keys and a new Disabled action. ZoomIt adds scrolling screenshots and text extraction. Image Resizer migrates from WPF to WinUI 3, and Advanced Paste fixes modifier-key injection issues with Electron/Chromium apps.

recent_posts.title: PowerToys 0.98 is here: new Keyboard Manager UX, the Command Palette Dock and better CursorWrap!
recent_posts.summary: PowerToys 0.98 ships with several notable updates. The Keyboard Manager gets a rebuilt WinUI 3 editor with a unified single-window view, per-remapping toggle switches, and shortcut-based enable/disable. A new Command Palette Dock (preview) lets users pin favorite commands to a persistent on-screen bar positioned at any screen edge. Command Palette also gains window transparency options, preserved search text, and significant performance improvements via caching and UI optimizations. CursorWrap's wrapping engine was rewritten for better multi-monitor layout support, with new options including a Ctrl/Shift activation mode. Always On Top gains title bar right-click pinning and transparency adjustment. Other changes include a ZoomIt video trim editor, Advanced Paste auto-copy hotkeys, and New+ context menu hiding.

recent_posts.title: Windows Terminal Preview 1.25 Release
recent_posts.summary: Windows Terminal 1.25 is now available in the Preview Channel, bringing several new features: a Settings Search UI, a graphical key binding editor for actions, built-in Kitty Keyboard Protocol support for better input disambiguation, and community translations for Serbian (Cyrillic) and Ukrainian. Miscellaneous improvements include configurable Unicode ambiguous character width, a 10-20% I/O throughput boost from re-enabled guided optimization, VS Code Modern Dark/Light color schemes, and several bug fixes around elevated sessions, search behavior, and rendering artifacts. Windows Terminal stable is also updated to 1.24 with features from the previous preview cycle.

recent_posts.title: PowerToys 0.97 is here: a big Command Palette update and a new mouse utility
recent_posts.summary: PowerToys 0.97 introduces major Command Palette improvements including UI customization with background images and color tinting, fallback ranking for search results, and a built-in extension to control PowerToys features directly. A new CursorWrap utility enables cursor wrapping across monitor edges for multi-monitor setups. CLI support expands to FancyZones, Image Resizer, and File Locksmith. Additional updates include faster Quick Access flyout, Light Switch integration with Night Light, and Advanced Paste enhancements with HEX color preview and image input support.

recent_posts.title: Windows Terminal Preview 1.22 Release
recent_posts.summary: Windows Terminal Preview 1.22 introduces several new features including Sixel image support, grapheme cluster support for better emoji and character rendering, a Snippets Pane for saving and quickly accessing command snippets, and Quick Fixes in CMD for unrecognized commands. The release also boasts a new console hosting subsystem for improved performance and additional usability and UI updates. Windows Terminal stable is updated to version 1.21, incorporating previous features. Users can install the preview via the Microsoft Store, GitHub, or winget.

recent_posts.title: Cascadia Code 2404.23
recent_posts.summary: Cascadia Code 2404.23 is a major version update with added support for quadrants, sextants, octants, large type pieces, more legacy computing symbols, and Nerd Fonts.

recent_posts.title: Windows Terminal Preview 1.20 Release
recent_posts.summary: Windows Terminal Preview 1.20 release introduces changes such as automatic deferral of package updates, colorful and crazy line styles, improved search result highlighting, usability updates, bug fixes, performance improvements, and accessibility improvements.

recent_posts.title: Terminal Chat in Windows Terminal Canary
recent_posts.summary: Windows Terminal Canary introduces Terminal Chat, an AI chat feature that allows users to get intelligent suggestions and explanations within their terminal. Users need to set up an Azure OpenAI Service endpoint and key to use Terminal Chat.

recent_posts.title: New enterprise-grade security controls for the Windows Subsystem for Linux
recent_posts.summary: New enterprise-grade security controls have been added to the Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL). These include monitoring WSL distros with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, managing WSL and its key security settings via Intune, and advanced networking controls for improved configurability and compatibility.

top_posts.title: Windows Terminal Preview 1.17 Release
top_posts.summary: The Windows Terminal team is back with our first release of the year! This release introduces version 1.17 to Windows Terminal Preview and updates Windows Terminal to Version 1.16 with these new features. Mica Support Windows Terminal now supports using Mica as a background material on Windows 11.
